Writes archiver fragments to a file with timestamps and buffered output.

# Purpose
`fd_archiver_writer.c` defines a tile that receives archive fragments from input links, updates each fragment with a timestamp delta, and writes the result to an archive file. It is part of the Firedancer tile system and is intended to run as a single archiver writer instance. The file sets the tile footprint, scratch layout, allowed file descriptors, and seccomp policy, then registers the tile entry point in `fd_tile_archiver_writer`.

The main runtime state is stored in `fd_archiver_writer_tile_ctx_t`, which keeps input link state, output buffering, fragment storage, timing data, and simple input counters. [`privileged_init`](<#privileged_init>) opens the archive file, and [`unprivileged_init`](<#unprivileged_init>) resets the file, binds each input link to its workspace range, and initializes the buffered output stream. During execution, [`during_housekeeping`](<#during_housekeeping>) records the current time, [`during_frag`](<#during_frag>) validates and copies each incoming fragment while setting `ns_since_prev_fragment`, and [`after_frag`](<#after_frag>) writes the fragment to the archive stream.
